sections.name: APConstants
sections.description: In this section you can change global settings for Jagged Alliance 2 v1.13

properties.name: AP_MAXIMUM
properties.description:
The maximum number of Action Points a merc may have.                                     
Should be 5x MAX_AP_CARRIED for game-balance purposes.         
INFO: You only have to change the AP_MAXIMUM value to get a new AP/BP system working. All other AP/BP values are adjusted dynamically by the game.
However, if a value differes from the default value, the game will use this value instead.

properties.name: MAX_AP_CARRIED
properties.description:
This is the maximum number of Action Points that may be carried over from a previous round.
It should be no more than 1/5 of AP_MAXIMUM, or game balance may be seriously disturbed.
